dataset: Synthetic temporary SQLite databases; 100000 inbound_messages and 100000 rate_events; no records expired; no production data

after.message_plan: SEARCH inbound_messages USING INDEX idx_messages_retention (workspace_id=? AND received_at<?)
after.rate_plan: SEARCH rate_events USING INDEX idx_rate_retention (workspace_id=? AND created_at<?)

limitations: Synthetic data and warm local filesystem cache; not a live production workload.
Database size uses one-character synthetic message bodies, so the relative storage increase differs from real conversations.
Insert-throughput microbenchmark was highly variable and is not used to claim a write-performance change.
Expired-row deletion bursts and concurrent webhook load were not measured.
